scope: Every third-party component considered for this plugin, included or not.
method: Read the installed source in full before copying or adapting it.
Record the upstream repository from ~/.agents/.skill-lock.json (sourceUrl + skillPath) or from the plugin cache directory.
Record the license text actually shipped with the component; where the installed copy had none, read the LICENSE file in the upstream repository.
Record sha256 of each installed source file as inspected, so a later diff can show whether upstream drifted.
Installed originals were read only. Nothing under ~/.agents or ~/.omp was modified.
